dataset.title: System identification campaign - Skywalker X8 UAV

license.name: CC0 1.0 Universal
license.citation_request: DataverseNO community norms and good scientific practice request citation of the dataset even though CC0 does not condition reuse on attribution.

collection.vehicle: Skywalker X8 small fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle
collection.split: The repository creators designate seven longitudinal files as training and two as validation.
important_caveats: Strong north-west wind with a significant vertical component was present.
The three data sources were manually synchronized.
Manual synchronization of SBC inputs can affect computed actuator delay.
Each file is a separate maneuver; dynamic state must reset at file boundaries.

local_projection.privacy_policy_for_derived_outputs: Exclude GPS_lon, GPS_lat, GPS_height, GPS_x, GPS_y, GPS_z, GPS_cog, and GPS_sog from all derived lesson artifacts.
local_projection.missing_value_policy: Abort on any nonfinite value, empty token, or row other than 41 fields. Do not impute.
